evidence.study: Vellingiri et al., 2020 (Mahila Housing Trust, Ahmedabad)
evidence.observed_reduction: Approx. 1.0°C lower mean daytime indoor air temperature compared to uncoated tin roofs
evidence.conditions: Tin sheet roofs, peak summer daylight hours
evidence.standard_caveat: Reference scenario: approximately 1°C lower daytime indoor temperature, based on a small Ahmedabad study. Local performance requires verification.

secondary_evidence.observed_reduction: 1.0 - 1.5°C lower indoor temperature during peak summer days

evidence.study: Vellingiri et al., 2020 (Mahila Housing Trust, Ahmedabad)
evidence.observed_finding: Standard unverified cowl/Airlite vents were associated with equal or higher indoor daytime temperatures when exterior ambient heat entered without thermal stack suction.
evidence.standard_caveat: Temperature reduction: assessment required. Ventilation efficacy depends on opening orientations, indoor ceiling height, and ambient diurnal range.

evidence.source: US EPA Heat Island Guidelines - Benefits of Trees & Vegetation
evidence.mechanism: Shading reduces peak surface heat by 11-25°C; evapotranspiration reduces ambient air temp by 1-5°C at neighborhood canopy scale.
evidence.caution: Newly planted saplings provide negligible shade in years 0-3. Must verify layout against adjacent rooftop solar panels to prevent future solar shading losses.

evidence.source: US EPA Urban Heat Island Reduction Compendium
evidence.mechanism: Localized ambient cooling within 30-50m buffer; ground water recharge and community recreational thermal refuge.
evidence.caution: Requires clear municipal land title, water access for dry season maintenance, and community stewardship.
